title: The Last Save Point / Remember
premise: At the final boss door a hero saves the game, and the save screen replays the whole journey.
comparison_notes: Original procedural 20-second study, 1280x720 at 24 fps; qualitative comparison to a longer upstream production. Native 320×180 indexed framebuffer, original 32-colour palette and hand-authored pixel font/sprites. Three save-memory locations; protected scarf red survives palette reduction.
